صِوَانٌ and صُوَانٌ (S, M, Msb, K) and صَوَانٌ (K) and صِيَانٌ (S, Msb, K) and صُيَانٌ and صَيَانٌ, (K,) but the third and the last two are extr., (TA,) A thing, (M, Msb, K,) or receptacle, (S,) [or chest or the like,] used as a repository (S, M, Msb, K) for a garment, (S, K,) as also ↓ مَصَانٌ , (Skr, cited by Reiske in Abulf. Ann. ii. 614,) [or for clothes,] or for a thing: (M, Msb:) pl.
أصْونَةٌ: (MA:) or ↓ مَصَانٌ signifies any place in which one reposits a garment. (TA in art. ضرس.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
